intro: Move at the speed of your workday. Designed for mobility and support, our Thrill chair features a tapered cushioned back for maximum comfort—because a great chair should work as hard as you do.

features.title: Your comfort, redefined
features.text: The tapered back design provides ample room for movement, while the gentle curve hugs your lower back for a supportive, cozy feel—making long work hours more comfortable.

features.title: Recline with ease
features.text: With the centre tilt synchro mechanism and multi-position locking, you can easily find your perfect recline angle—whether you’re working hard or taking a breather.

features.title: Tailored just for you
features.text: Customise your chair with various upholstery options, armrests, and backrest heights to match your workspace and style. Two distinct variants ensure comfort for all levels within your team.

features.title: Arm support that works with you
features.text: The height-adjustable 1D armrests provide full support for your arms, helping you stay comfortable throughout your workday.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
